_help: Brands and rights holders shown with logos on the site. Key = the slug used in profile.html?id=. name = how it's written in deal names (brand or property side of 'Brand × Property'). domain = official website, used to fetch the logo from Brandfetch (needs site.brandfetch in deals.json). logo = optional path to a logo file in assets/logos/ that overrides Brandfetch. aliases = other names the same organisation appears under. Anything not listed still gets a page and a monogram. leagues = the club strips on the archive, in order. cat = industry category for brands; ptype = property type (Club & team, National team, League & competition, Event, Governing body, Athlete & talent, Venue, Other). Both are used by the Brands, Properties and Categories pages; tools/enrich.py fills them for new names where it can. parent = the slug of the company that owns this brand (e.g. Carlton Draught -> carlton-and-united-breweries). Deals stay filed under the name the club uses; the league map rolls brands up to the parent when counting clubs.

american-express.name: American Express
american-express.pnote: Uses sport and entertainment for Card Member access: presales, premium lounges and hosting (F1 including Melbourne, NFL, tennis, golf, music); building with Gen Z and millennials.

blue-cross-blue-shield-of-louisiana.name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Louisiana

blue-cross-blue-shield-of-michigan.name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

chemist-warehouse.name: Chemist Warehouse
chemist-warehouse.pnote: Backs AFL as a long-term health and wellbeing partner, with a multi-year umpire pathway commitment, so it fits properties with grassroots and community reach.

coca-cola.name: Coca-Cola
coca-cola.pnote: Backs national teams to connect communities through shared moments, with fan campaigns and retail promotions around events like the World Cup.

coopers.name: Coopers
coopers.pnote: Australia's largest independent, family-owned brewer, growing in a shrinking beer market (Queensland fastest). Backs community and grassroots sport (NSWRU Subbies, Football SA, Norwood), SA venues (Coopers Stadium to 2028), Supercars to 2027, golf (Blitz), tennis (Kooyong), surf and live music. Lion pourage keeps it out of Adelaide Oval cricket and most SANFL clubs.

emirates.name: Emirates
emirates.pnote: Uses global sport (tennis, football, rugby) for worldwide profile and hospitality, with campaigns that bring in younger fans.

energyaustralia.name: EnergyAustralia
energyaustralia.pnote: Backs leagues and venues, not clubs: left its Port Adelaide major partnership (2014-16) when it changed strategy, ran the MCG energy partnership 2016-22 (first major stadium on 100% renewables), and since March 2026 is Official Energy Partner of the AFL, AFLW and Marvel Stadium on a five-year deal matched to Golden Plains wind. Retails in NSW, Victoria, south-east Queensland, SA and the ACT only (not WA, Tasmania, the NT or NZ).

gatorade.name: Gatorade
gatorade.pnote: Pairs elite stars with grassroots and youth sport (5v5 football, college women's athletes) to widen its reach and help remove barriers to participation.

hawke-s-bay-community-fitness-centre-tru.name: Hawke's Bay Community Fitness Centre Trust

las-vegas-convention-and-visitors-author.name: Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority

longines.name: Longines
longines.pnote: Only backs elegant, individual sports (equestrian, flat racing, alpine skiing, tennis, gymnastics) under 'Elegance is an attitude'; avoids contact team sports.

mcdonald-s.name: McDonald's
mcdonald-s.pnote: Backs grassroots and junior sport through local restaurants, aiming to improve the health and wellbeing of Australian children.

new-balance.name: New Balance
new-balance.pnote: Sits at the intersection of sport, style and culture, with a core 16 to 34 audience that cares about equity, diversity and mental health.

new-york-knicks-new-york-rangers.name: New York Knicks / New York Rangers

new-zealand-campus-of-innovation-and-spo.name: New Zealand Campus of Innovation and Sport

sacramento-county-department-of-behavior.name: Sacramento County Department of Behavioral Health

sailgp-hong-kong-sail-grand-prix.name: SailGP Hong Kong Sail Grand Prix

telstra.name: Telstra
telstra.pnote: Naming rights partner of the NRL and NRLW and invests in grassroots and regional rugby league through junior club packs and Footy Country.

toyota.name: Toyota
toyota.pnote: Backs the AFL as premier partner from community footy to the elite level, tying it to the Good for Footy grassroots program and its dealer network.

tyrepower.name: Tyrepower
tyrepower.pnote: Backs motorsport, NBL, AFL, NRL and netball clubs to connect its independent local stores with fans and communities, with a push into women's sport and grassroots.

visa.name: Visa
visa.pnote: Global payments brand whose Australian sponsorship centres on women's sport, especially women's football (FIFA Women's World Cup, AFC Women's Asian Cup 2026, 'Let's Get On Her Side').
